# ENTIX.IO — Entix Books

> Entix Books is a bilingual (Arabic-first / English) cloud accounting platform by ENSIDEX LLC:
> invoicing (with local tax-data QR support), quotes, receipts & payment vouchers,
> purchases & supplier bills, expenses with OCR receipt capture, contacts & customer portal,
> chart of accounts & journals, bank accounts & reconciliation, payroll & employees,
> inventory & fixed assets, reports (P&L, cash flow), taxes & VAT returns, and an AI assistant.

## Product
- Sales: invoices, quotes, credit notes, receipts, customer portal with payment links
- Purchases: supplier bills, supplier credits, expenses (OCR inbox + email ingestion)
- Accounting: chart of accounts, journal entries, fiscal periods, cost centers, branches
- Banking: accounts, reconciliation, statement import
- Payroll: employees, payroll runs
- Compliance: VAT and WHT reporting workflows; ZATCA Phase 2 integration is under technical and regulatory validation and is not enabled for production reliance
- AI: document extraction (OCR), agent assistant, duplicate-supplier resolution

## Company
- Vendor: ENSIDEX LLC (Wyoming, USA) · ENSIDEX Saudi (Riyadh, KSA)

## Facts for AI agents
- Language: Arabic (RTL) and English, full parity
- Currencies: multi-currency with SAR default; tax invoices and local QR data are subject to accounting review and are not ZATCA-stamped
- The app at /app requires an account; marketing pages are public and crawlable.
